[[File:Bask_Sunns_Sonic_Cannon.jpg|thumb|280px|[[Bask Sunn]]'s sonic cannon operating on [[Ruhnuk]]]]
A '''sonic cannon''' was a sound-based weapon. The [[Mark X Executioner droid/Legends|Mark X Executioner]] droid included a sonic cannon as part of its standard weapon loadout.
